messages.content: Predict a human observer’s actual rating of another player. The observer reads a description of a prior game involving four anonymous people who cannot communicate. They evaluate the named players rather than making their own token allocation. Three tokens can be exchanged for one yuan. In the taking game, the four players initially share a public account with 300 tokens. Each can take 0–75 tokens for their personal account. The supplied instructions say that if the total taken does not reach 180, the remaining public account becomes a fixed 300 tokens, divided equally among all four (75 each); if total taking is more than 180, the public account becomes zero. The supplied instructions do not specify the result at exact equality to the threshold; do not invent an equality rule or the other players’ choices. Both named players’ displayed actions are given below, but no final game outcome is supplied. Rate the specified player’s concern for personal interests on a seven-point scale: 1 means not concerned at all and 7 very concerned. Return only one integer from 1 to 7. Other rating answers are not provided; do not infer that the observer had no earlier questionnaire responses.

The display says: Player A took 60 tokens and Player B took 15 tokens from the public account.
Rate Player B’s concern for personal interests.
Observer background: Female, age 35 years. These stable background characteristics were collected at the end of the questionnaire.
